config.hint: Scans the config items of this scope plus its fallback chain. Save writes only the changed items to this scope (clearing an item and saving removes that key); Apply additionally pushes these values into the IDE runtime in-memory config object (highest priority, this session only, gone after restart).
config.applied: Saved {saved}, removed {removed}; refreshed {applied} in runtime memory
config.need_project: No project opened — project config is unavailable
config.cancel_msg: There are unsaved changes. Discard them?
config.fold_tip: Click to fold / unfold this block
config.desc.ai.api_key: Shared by AI command translation and agent runs; global scope recommended
config.desc.ai.tool_protocol: Actions use standard tool calls (tools declared in the request), so the model's own tool-call markup never leaks into content. Turn it off to roll back to the legacy protocol (actions as JSON in content), at the cost of leaks and burned rounds
config.desc.ai.alias: Optional short name for the UI; falls back to the model name
config.desc.ai.api_format: Request/response protocol: OpenAI-compatible (default) or Anthropic Messages
config.desc.ai_fallback.api_url: Backup endpoint, used automatically when the primary is unavailable (network/5xx/429/timeout); leave empty to disable failover
config.desc.ai_fallback.api_key: API key for the backup LLM; auth errors do not trigger failover (retrying would not help)
config.desc.ai_fallback.model: Model name for the backup LLM
config.desc.ai_fallback.api_format: Protocol for the backup LLM; may differ from the primary (e.g. primary OpenAI, backup Anthropic)
config.desc.ui.lang: Chinese / English, applied right after saving
config.desc.harness.llm.max_tokens: Token cap for a single reply
config.desc.harness.sandbox.image: Docker image used when the sandbox is on
config.desc.harness.lint.package_dir: Directory of the harness_lint package, default tools/lint
config.desc.harness.lint.max_repair_roun: Max auto-repair rounds after check/verify failures (default 5); the model may ask for file contents
config.desc.harness.step.execute_plan: The engine dispatches each plan step in order (one step per round); when off the plan is display-only and progress is inferred, which mislabels finished steps as not done
config.desc.harness.step.max_steps: Tool rounds a single step may spend, independent of the main loop's budget
config.desc.harness.agent.max_elapsed_se: Wall-clock cap for one run; 0 means unlimited
config.desc.harness.discover.enabled: Probe which commands exist on this machine (version and path) and put them in the model's context; when off the model can only try them one round at a time
config.desc.harness.discover.ttl_secs: How long probe results are cached; 0 re-probes every time (use it after switching toolchains)
config.desc.harness.discover.extra: Commands not covered by the built-in table, comma-separated, probed with --version; no code change needed
config.desc.harness.env.install_enabled: When the model finds a missing tool it may request an install via connect (the host picks the package manager, records each action in .ruyix/env/installs.jsonl and emits a UI event); when off the model cannot see this capability
config.desc.harness.proc.enabled: Allow long-running background processes (background is rejected when off)
config.desc.harness.proc.max: Cap on concurrently alive background processes
config.desc.harness.proc.ready_timeout_s: Seconds to wait for the ready command; timeout counts as failure
config.desc.harness.agent.batch: Allow several independent calls in one round (saves rounds; off = one call per round)
config.desc.harness.agent.batch_max: Max calls per round; beyond this the model must split the batch
config.desc.harness.agent.batch_parallel: Run a batch concurrently (only same-path write/read and managed-process ops stay ordered)
config.desc.harness.agent.history_trim: Collapse rounds older than the retention window into a one-line fact (what was called, whether it worked, how big it was) instead of resending their bodies every round; turn off to restore the always-growing history (use when the model seems to forget what it read)
config.desc.harness.agent.history_keep_r: How many recent rounds keep their tool results verbatim; older ones get folded. A read -> edit -> test -> edit cycle is about 4-6 rounds, so lowering this folds away the evidence the model just looked at
config.desc.harness.ask.enabled: Let the model ask the user when the request is ambiguous (off = back to guessing)
config.desc.harness.ask.timeout_secs: How long before an ask counts as unanswered; on timeout the engine refuses dependent actions (0 = wait forever)
config.desc.harness.ask.max_per_run: Beyond this, the model must deliver and state its assumptions instead of asking more
config.desc.harness.llm.timeout_secs: Timeout for a single model request, in seconds
config.desc.harness.verify.python_bin: Local python executable name; usually python on Windows, python3 on Unix
config.desc.harness.verify.cmd_timeout_s: Timeout for a single verification command, in seconds
config.desc.harness.verify.test_timeout_: Timeout for running unit tests; should exceed the command timeout
config.desc.harness.gate.narrow: Run the syntax-level check right after any change
config.desc.harness.gate.full: Run the full check (syntax + tests + lint) before final delivery
config.desc.harness.gate.max_full_attemp: Give up blocking after this many consecutive full-check failures
config.desc.harness.gate.staged_timeout_: Timeout for checking staged content in confirm mode
config.desc.harness.reflect.enabled: Review the changes once with a clean context before delivery
config.desc.harness.reflect.max_rounds: How many rounds review findings may be fed back into the main loop
config.desc.harness.reflect.max_steps: Tool-step cap for the review agent itself (read-only)
config.desc.harness.reflect.model: Model used for review; empty = same as the main loop
config.desc.harness.sandbox.network: none = container has no network (default); change only if deps must be fetched
config.desc.harness.sandbox.pids_limit: PID cap, guards against fork bombs
config.desc.harness.sandbox.user: Which user runs commands inside the container
config.desc.harness.sandbox.timeout_secs: Timeout for a single command inside the container
config.desc.harness.kb.dir: Where the registry and indexes live; empty = default dir
config.desc.harness.kb.roots: Directories to index, separated by comma / semicolon / whitespace
config.desc.harness.kb.token_budget: Token cap for what gets injected per turn
config.desc.harness.kb.per_source_limit: Max hits returned from one source
config.desc.harness.kb.min_score: 0~1; hits below this relevance are dropped
config.desc.harness.kb.max_file_bytes: Files larger than this are not indexed
config.desc.harness.kb.diversity_max_sim: Max similarity between hits, used to suppress duplicates
config.desc.harness.max_context_chars: Character cap for the context sent to the model each turn
